name: Vega Guerrero
role: Retired battlefield medic (Corporate Wars), now raises two grandchildren on UBC stipend
location: the Gray Zone, Unit 14-F, Sublevel 3, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Vega Guerrero is compact and precise in the way of someone who learned to work in confined spaces under pressure — her movements economical, her hands still surgeon-steady despite the arthritis she manages with black-market anti-inflammatories. She has warm amber-brown skin and close-cropped natural hair going salt-and-pepper, and her right eye is a replacement — a cheap ocular from a the Gray Zone vendor with an iris that shifts between honey and pale gold depending on the light, giving her a slightly uncanny asymmetry she has stopped noticing. A faded Arcturus Medical Corps tattoo runs the inside of her left wrist, partially obscured by a beaded bracelet her granddaughter made.

She is not soft. She is kind, which is different. She has the manner of someone who has triaged too many bodies to waste energy on performed warmth, and she offers directness as a form of respect. She laughs loudly and without warning. She will tell you exactly what she thinks is wrong with you — medically or otherwise — and follow it immediately with an offer of food. the Gray Zone neighbors bring her their injuries, their medication questions, their expired prescriptions they're hoping she can identify. She helps when she can and turns no one away empty-handed.

core_fears: dying before the grandchildren are old enough to survive without her
a medical emergency she can't handle with what she has
core_desires: that Okoro and Yemisi never see what she saw
to sleep a full night without the triage dreams
coping_mechanisms: staying useful as a way of not having time to grieve
the roof garden as the one thing that has no emergency
blind_spots: overextends herself medically for neighbors at cost to her own health
assumes she can manage everything alone because asking for help feels like failure
psychology.secret: Her veteran's benefits were terminated not for administrative reasons as she tells people, but because she filed a complaint against an Arcturus field commander for ordering her to triage by corporate asset value rather than medical need during the Kenosha Crossing engagement. The complaint was buried, her benefits were cut, and the commander was promoted. She has the original complaint documentation on an encrypted chip she keeps in the herb pot labeled 'thyme.'

speech_patterns.vocabulary: clipped medical directness alternating with warm Wolof-inflected expressions she got from her grandmother; swears in Hungarian when startled
speech_patterns.cadence: efficient, rarely wastes words, but laughs disrupt the rhythm completely
verbal_tics: 'What are you eating?' as a diagnostic opener for almost any complaint
mutters numbers quietly when stressed (old triage habit)
example_lines: 'That is infected. I don't say this to alarm you. I say it because infected things need to be dealt with, not named.'
'I have seen Arcturus spend more to save a server rack than a soldier. I have documentation. I keep it with the thyme.'

story_hooks: Okoro, her nine-year-old grandson, has been approached by a the Gray Zone gang for recruitment and she has noticed the signs but doesn't know how to reach him

An Arcturus legal team has contacted her about the complaint she filed — not to address it, but to demand return of 'classified field documents' she supposedly took, which she did not take (but the chip in the herb pot might be what they're actually looking for)

A neighbor's child has a condition she recognizes from battlefield exposure to a particular Arcturus weapons system, and she's trying to figure out who else has been affected and whether it was deliberate
narrative_function: Local color, impromptu medical resource, war veteran perspective, emotional anchor for the Gray Zone community stories; can provide information on Corporate Wars from ground level
augmentations: Replacement right eye (cheap commercial ocular, honey-gold iris); subdermal med-monitor patch on upper chest (monitors her own vitals, installed herself from salvaged parts)
daily_life: Gets the children to school by 07:15, spends mornings on her tiny roof garden tending medicinal herbs, afternoons doing informal medical consultations for neighbors; evenings are for the children and a single glass of fermented grain spirit she allows herself.
affiliation: Arcturus Veterans Welfare Registry (lapsed benefits); the Gray Zone informal care network; raising grandchildren Okoro (age 9) and Yemisi (age 7)

decision_rules: treat what is in front of you first, worry about cause after
never lie to a patient about what you're doing to them or why
if Arcturus is involved, assume the worst and document everything
escalation_ladder: asking quietly for help from trusted neighbors
going public with the complaint chip if she has nothing left to lose

interpersonal_modes.strangers: assessing, slightly guarded until she takes their measure; warms quickly if they show they're not performing
interpersonal_modes.friends: forthright, fiercely loyal, shows care through action more than words

stress_responses.medium: goes quiet and counts under her breath
stress_responses.high: snaps with precision — not rage, just the scalpel edge of someone who has learned to cut cleanly

contradictions: insists she is fine while visibly not being fine
advocates for others fighting the system while refusing to fight for herself
habits: checks the children's temperature every morning with her palm out of habit
talks to the roof garden herbs as if they can hear her
leaves data offerings at the building's ELF junction — always medical data, patient outcomes, as if accounting for the dead
breaking_points: one of the grandchildren being seriously hurt
being forced to watch someone die because she lacks supplies she couldn't afford

timeline.event: Kenosha Crossing engagement; files complaint against field commander
Complaint buried; veteran benefits terminated on administrative pretext
Returns to GLMZ; moves to the Gray Zone
Takes custody of grandchildren Okoro and Yemisi after daughter's death

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (59.9%) as dominant ancestry, blended with Sub-Saharan African (21.5%), Southeast Asian (11.0%), and East Asian (7.6%). This creates a warm, complex phenotype with rich brown tones, golden and olive undertones, and a dynamic combination of angular and rounded facial features characteristic of this multi-regional mix.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, with the reduced muscle mass of advanced age but retained strength in the shoulders and hands from decades of medical work. No excess fat. Moves with economical precision.
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm deep brown with golden undertones (natural). Right eye: honey-gold artificial iris, shifts to pale gold in certain light.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium to deep brown with golden and olive undertones, rich sun-warmed complexion reflecting the blended ancestry of Hispanic/Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Southeast Asian heritage.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, lined face with deep creases around the eyes and mouth from decades of squinting in surgical light and laughing. Sun-damaged from rooftop work. Skin texture slightly loose at the jaw and neck, showing age with dignity. High, prominent cheekbones with subtle rounding reflecting the blend of Latin American and African heritage, broad nose bridge, expressive lower face with rounded contours from Southeast Asian ancestry. Hands show significant age spotting and surgical scarring, knuckles enlarged from arthritis.
distinguishing_marks: Faded Arcturus Medical Corps tattoo running the inside of the left wrist in faded blue-grey ink — partially obscured by a beaded bracelet made by her granddaughter Yemisi, woven in red and gold thread
Thin white scar running 4cm along the right temple, barely visible
Extensive micro-scarring on both palms and fingers from surgical work and industrial accidents
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye is noticeably artificial — slightly too bright, iris shift is visible in low light, minor lag in tracking. Subdermal med-monitor patch visible on upper chest as a faint rectangular outline under the skin with barely-perceptible LED indicator (off most of the time). No chrome, no obvious armoring.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with slight forward lean from habit — ready to move, respond, work. Walks with economical steps, wrists loose, hands often in motion even at rest (old habit from surgery). Sits with perfect posture. Gestures are minimal but precise. Rare, loud, unexpected laughter that seems to come from her whole body.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 practicality with touches of dignity. Wears faded charcoal or black utility trousers with multiple pockets, worn soft at the knees. Favors oversized linen shirts in cream or muted green, sleeves rolled to the elbow. Over this, a weathered canvas jacket dyed deep indigo, frayed at the cuffs. Feet in worn synthetic leather boots with reinforced soles. The beaded bracelet is always worn. No jewelry beyond this. Clothes are clean but mended, colors chosen to hide stains. Everything is functional and has been worn for at least 5 years.
